author: Good Enough
description:
What would happen if you exited your ship deep inside an alien ocean at the exact point where you became neutrally buoyant? On a world as extreme as HD 80606 b, surviving outside the ship would depend entirely on whether you had protection from the crushing pressure, extreme heat, and violent conditions surrounding you.

Without a protective suit, a human body would be overwhelmed almost immediately by the environment. But with an indestructible space suit, you could theoretically remain suspended at the planet’s buoyancy point and experience what it would be like to float inside one of the most hostile worlds imaginable.

This Short explores HD 80606 b, extreme exoplanets, ocean planets, buoyancy, alien worlds, and what would happen to a human trying to survive deep inside a planet unlike anything on Earth.
title: Inside an Ocean Planet 🪐😵‍💫 #space #exoplanets #astronomy #galaxy
